prompt.project_info: Raw photorealistic phone-photo aesthetic capturing a candid summer-heat portrait in a domestic interior.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with deep tan, visible pores and freckles, dark hair in a high messy bun with loose flyaways, a small vertical-line tattoo behind the right ear, script tattoo on the inner left bicep, white halter bikini top, gold pendant chain and small gold hoops.
prompt.composition_elements: Portrait 3:4 close-up from mid-torso upward. Use an extreme low angle looking upward, head turned to the viewer's right in profile, chin raised naturally, torso angled slightly back and arms extending out of frame. Keep the white bikini and supplied tattoos visible without adding body-part emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong directional natural daylight from the left creates crisp wet-skin highlights, deep neck and face shadows, raw summer heat and a neutral domestic atmosphere with a ceiling fan.
